{"consolidated_memory":"ROUTE SHADOWING IN api/gateway/router.go - THREE INCIDENTS

Common across all three:
- Component: api/gateway/router.go (api gateway side)
- Problem: route shadowing in the router
- Reproducibility: curl the two overlapping prefixes in order
- Signal: wrong handler name in the request span
- Stack: Go
- Covering test: api/gateway/router_test.go

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-19]
- Trigger: input list came in empty
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #2054 on branch fix/route-shadowing-1
- Result: memory settled at 11 MB instead of climbing past 4 GB

INCIDENT 2 [2026-06-17]
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #5336 on branch fix/route-shadowing-2
- Result: nightly rollup matched the source counts for 11 days running

INCIDENT 3 [2026-08-15]
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR #7512 on branch fix/route-shadowing-3
- Result: job finished in 86 minutes instead of 1 hour"}
